# Fumbo Ai

> AI chatbots and automation that understand your market.

Fumbo Ai Ltd builds AI chatbots and automations for teams worldwide. Chatbots answer customers on web, WhatsApp, social, and email. Automations clear the work behind those conversations: tickets, orders, CRM updates, and a clean handoff to a person. We design, ship, and stay. Headquartered in Accra.
